title: ID0452653 - DC/Si-D/FI - [MP / R6 170002026] Converter issues and replacement
description:
Dear support,
We have now 4 chargers where we have noticed constant converter failure.
In some chargers there has been hundreds in past 2 weeks. See picture below.
Is it okay if we replace these converters.
Thanks again for the help.
Best regards
Sakari Harjunpää

additional_info.subject: ID0452653 - DC/Si-D/FI - [MP / R6 170002026] Converter issues and replacement CRM:03057000014
additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0452653
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-FI SI E Queue. The first response has been sent to the customer, and we kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer: Plugit Finland Oy
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
Helsinki - Vuosaari
Charger ID / Serial No.:
kXnNip
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Low
Possible solution:
1. Please check if the fast shutdown cables are connected correctly
2. swap the affected converter with the neighbour
2.a) if the problem persists in the effected converter then please replace that converter
2.b) if the problem is now in the working converter then it is possible that the fast shutdown cables are faulty
MLFB's for Converter and Fast shutdown cables if needed:
8EM5903-0AA01-0AA2 - Power Converter AC/DC 20kW
8EM5903-0AA02-0AA3 - Power Conv. Cable Fast Shutdown 4-Pole
8EM5903-0AA02-0AA4 - Power Conv. Cable Fast Shutdown 1+3-Pole
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-FI SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require expert support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Calin Ienei
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
